data.title: 阿蕾克希亚 · 破晓道场的奋力挥刃
data.description: 清晨古朴的皇家剑道道场木地板上，晨光穿透纸格窗形成一道道丁达尔光束。阿蕾克希亚双手握紧铁剑斩下，汗珠沿着锁骨滑落，眼神执着不屈。
data.location: spacious traditional timber sword dojo with polished wooden floorboards and dust motes
data.action: mid-swing of a training broadsword, arms extended forward with powerful martial posture, sweat gleaming on throat, fiercely determined red eyes
data.lighting: 破晓侧面朝阳与丁达尔光柱
data.promptProse: Alexia in lightweight training gear completes a powerful sword strike across a sunlit dojo, determined crimson eyes fixed forward through morning light beams.
data.animaCaption: Morning sun shafts illuminate the gleaming blade as sweat drips down her neck.
